title: `voids/biological-cognitive-closure` L69 says the three-factor mystical pattern holds "across … Indian Hindus, and East Asian Buddhists" — MacLean et al. 2012 report the opposite ("the alternate models outperformed the Hood and Stace models" for India and Tibetan/Chinese Buddhist samples); its "ineffability factor" is not in that model and its quote "defying expression" is unsourced; plus fold the instrument-discount rule into `concepts/phenomenological-evidence`
